vote.title: To authorize and direct the Director of Public Safety to enter into contract with NicheVision Forensic LLC., in accordance with sole source provisions of City Code, for the purchase of ten STRmix concurrent-use licenses to aid in the interpretation of mixed DNA profiles for the Division of Police Crime Lab; to authorize a transfer within the General Government Grant Fund, to authorize the expenditure of $183,075.00 from the General Government Grant Fund, and to declare an emergency. ($183,075.00)
vote.description: This item was approved on the Consent Agenda.
